more_info.overview: Propyl gallate is the propyl ester of gallic acid, specified as a phenolic antioxidant for food use. Its antioxidant role is to slow oxidation that can cause rancidity or unwanted colour changes during storage. The specified material is supplied as white crystalline material or solid. Only a limited amount dissolves in water, according to the specification.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain sweet baked goods; sauces; potato-, cereal-, flour- or starch-based snacks; processed nuts; nut butters and nut spreads; non-heat–treated meat products.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
